share.mail.subject: Your test report {date}
share.mail.body: Here is the report from your test on {date}.
share.mail.body_many: Here is the collected report from your {n} tests on {date}.
share.mail.body_fit: The FIT file is the test as a workout, second by second. It can be uploaded to Strava, Garmin Connect and similar services.
share.mail.plan_body: Here is your training plan: {weeks} weeks from {start}. The PDF is the whole plan with one page per week.
share.mail.plan_ics: The calendar file (.ics) puts the workouts in the calendar on your phone:
share.mail.plan_ics_iphone: - iPhone: tap the file in the mail and choose Add All.
share.mail.plan_ics_android: - Android: open the file with the phone's calendar. If that does not work, import it in Google Calendar on a computer (Settings → Import & export).
share.mail.plan_ics_update: If you get a new plan later, the new calendar file replaces the workouts instead of adding them twice.
share.mail.questions: Get in touch if you have any questions.
share.mail.test_body: This is a test mail from the program Tröskel. The e-mail settings work.
share.mail.err.not_set_up: E-mail is not set up. Fill in the server, the user and the app password under Settings → E-mail.
share.mail.err.sender: The sender's address is missing or cannot be read. Fill it in under Settings → E-mail.
share.mail.err.address: The e-mail address cannot be read.
share.mail.err.too_big: The attachments are too large for e-mail ({mb} MB). Save the report as a PDF and hand it over another way.
share.mail.err.auth: The server did not accept the login. Check the user and the app password. Gmail needs an app password, not the ordinary password.
share.mail.err.recipient: The server did not accept the recipient's address. Check the athlete's address.
share.mail.err.tls: No encrypted connection to {host}:{port}. Check the port and the kind of encryption (587 with STARTTLS, 465 with TLS).
share.mail.err.smtp: The server did not accept the mail ({code}).
share.mail.err.connect: Could not reach {host}:{port}. Check the server, the port and the internet connection.
